[[File:Hondo_Ohnaka.png|thumb|right|200px|Hondo Ohnaka wearing a Desevrar Infantry Helmet]]
A '''Desevrar Infantry Helmet''' was a helmet used by the [[Desevrar Infantry]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Desevro/Legends|Desevro]]. The helmet was usually worn with a pair of protective glasses. [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]], leader of a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|gang]], was known to wear this type of helmet.
